meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出一份可点击、能分支跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把想法或网页做成能上台演示的交互幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable presentation deck with branching and speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas or a webpage into an interactive deck to present.

howto.what: Claude 会把演示、路演或现有网页写成可导航的 HyperFrames 幻灯片:离散页面、逐步显示、热点分支跳转、带演讲者备注的演示模式;产出是 deck,不是 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要 slideshow 或幻灯片时直接开始;若你说「演示文稿」「pitch deck」「转换这个页面」等,它会先问你是否要做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片再动手。

howto.what_en: Claude builds HyperFrames slideshows: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, presenter mode with speaker notes, and converting an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow. Adjacent requests like “presentation” or “convert this page” get a confirmation question first; requests routed from /hyperframes are already confirmed.
